_about: Canonical vocabulary of carriere-kit. Every database record, tool and agent uses ONLY these ids. To add a value, edit this file in a pull request and explain why in the PR. tools/db.py validate rejects anything else.

board_status.live: Board answers and lists at least one posting
board_status.empty: Board answers but lists zero postings
board_status.dead: Board does not answer (wrong slug, company moved ATS, closed)

sectors.ai-data: AI labs, AI products, data platforms
sectors.consulting: Strategy, management, IT and Big Four consulting
sectors.energy: Energy production, grids, renewables, energy services
sectors.media-communications: Media, agencies, PR, public affairs consultancies
sectors.public-sector-eu: Public administrations, EU institutions and agencies
sectors.other: Does not fit any sector yet (propose a new one in a PR)

job_families.data-ai: Data analysis, data science, AI/ML, AI operations
job_families.strategy-operations: Strategy, operations, chief of staff, founder's associate, bizops

seniority.graduate: Graduate programme, trainee, entry level (0-1 year)
seniority.lead: Team lead, head of, manager of managers

posting_status.open: Confirmed open on the official source at verified_on
posting_status.unverified: Seen, not yet confirmed on the official source

evidence_source.aggregator: Third-party job board (never enough alone to mark a posting open)

note_topics.hiring-trap: Recurring gap between job title and real requirements
note_topics.ghost-job: Signals of stale or fake postings
note_topics.market-size: How thin or deep a market is for a profile
note_topics.search-tactic: Search terms or channels that work better

pipeline_types.application: Formal application submitted through a portal or email
pipeline_types.research-round: A search session with its own result table

pipeline_status.waiting: Sent, waiting for an answer (needs follow_up date)
pipeline_status.closed: Finished (accepted, withdrawn, no answer after follow-ups)
pipeline_status.rejected: Rejected by them or ruled out by you
